correctness.rationale: For a pure pair the majority is its two leaves; for a mixed pair the hub plus one matching leaf are the majority. This proves the invariant/freeze step. Finite a.s. activation follows from positivity of all \(\pi_j\). The first selected pure-versus-mixed edge decides success when the hub initially opposes the unique pure-petal color. Independent Bernoulli initial states give the two disjoint color-specific probability polynomials, with weights canceling by \(\sum_j\pi_j=1\). Post-freeze the hub is an i.i.d. categorical sample of fixed petal colors. Coupon-collector stages give exact conditional mean times. The standard-library exact rational Markov computation passed 21,906 checks for all initial states at \(m=1,\ldots,6\) and two weight patterns; this finite verification is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 2021 motivating work explicitly identifies accurate small-hypergraph dynamics and structured consensus-time analysis as meaningful open extensions. The complete formula on every finite one-core sunflower is a natural exactly solvable boundary case showing that connectivity and perpetual opportunity to interact do not force unanimity. The exponential law \((3/4)^{m-1}\), its independence of arbitrary positive meeting weights, the sharp rare-minority scaling, and the persistent-recurrent class supply nontrivial structural and quantitative benchmarks beyond a toy single-instance computation.
